title.narrative: EU Policy and Outreach Partnership in China 2023

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU Policy and Outreach Partnership in China 2023 - The relation with China is one of the EU¿s most important and complex one, raising both significant potential for cooperation and benefit in political and economic terms, as well as a multitude of challenges across political, economic and human rights spectrums. Public and cultural diplomacy constitute an important tool enabling the EU to engage meaningfully with selected audiences in China, stimulate cooperation and address challenges, thus supporting the implementation of EU foreign policy objectives. Sustained and effective engagement with target audiences in China increases mutual understanding, improves the perception regarding the EU, its policies, values and principles, and ultimately, nurtures trust and builds networks and alliances with like-minded societal partners.The proposed action aims to support the European Union, represented by the EU Delegation in China, in its endeavour of shaping a favourable context for EU-China dialogues, setting the stage for intensified bilateral relations and advancing the EU¿s policy priorities in China, as discussed also in the context of the High level dialogue on ¿People-to-People¿ and the Higher Education Cooperation and Exchange Platform. The following fields of action are envisaged: 1. Reinforce the capacity of the EU Delegation to China to undertake constant and long-term engagement with selected audiences in China and develop partnerships and alliances with key stakeholders.2. Improve the perception, attractiveness and likeability of the EU among target audiences in China, thus building trust and facilitating the establishment of constructive partnerships.3. Foster the role of culture in external relations and engage with stakeholders of the cultural scene in China, thus increasing mutual understanding and promoting diversity, inclusiveness and intercultural tolerance.

comment.narrative: EUPOP China 2023 continues and enhances the work conducted under previous public diplomacy projects but considers a new dimension of engagement in line with changing environment for public diplomacy in China therefore the baseline is set to 0.

3 bilateral partnership strategiespolicy dialogues have been influenced through thematic campaigns 1 Green Transition environment climate energy sustainable development 2 Peopletopeople and culture 3 Political issues social development

The project influenced through targeted thematic campaigns three strands of EU China policy exchanges. They nurtured a better mutual understanding with various local partners as well as EU Member States. All of them are aligned with the EU in advance to support the policy themes and key messages of the projects campaigns. The project planned and implemented various offline campaigns after the lifting of COVIDrestrictions in China with a hybrid of both online and offline. Achievements exceeded the expectations.1 Green Transition environment climate energy sustainable development The campaign on climate was designed with engagement of a local university partner through an online lecture series combined with offline practical research. The campaign is still ongoing. Early implementation revealed that it goes into the right direction with promising outcomes. It could be an effective way to support EU green transition on public engagement and target audience. To promote the EU green transition in combination with cultural diplomacy a video series to promote EU sustainable lifestyle is well received via social media. 13 episodes are planned and 6 of them have been released by the end of August.2 Peopletopeople and culture Nurtured through new activities such as the EU culture square in Europe Day or through the continuity of the previous campaign successes like the European Virtual Museum. Both had supported well the EU cultural diplomacy in an interactive way to the target audience. 3 Political issues social development An interactive QA column ran in March 2023 to support EU gender equality policy social development and human rights in connection with International Womens Day. It was delivered with about 2 million online engagements.
